Original work
The Technic arrangement, deterministic placements, program, independent
equations, lessons, observations, validation and original analytical figures
were authored for this model. Reusable author-owned runtime, generator and
audit methods were adapted from earlier model add-ons with their notices
preserved. No earlier model is repackaged as this new mechanism.

Current brief and collection
The user supplied BRICKWRIGHT_MODEL_BUILDER(3).md, SHA-256
b741c90e72e66ae01ebf7dfc325699b8f686ef70545d29bd967f2cc9809a3bcc.
The actual cumulative collection baseline is catalog.supplied-plus-turnwise.json,
58 choices / 50 assemblies, SHA-256
10ff213723f9df4171bc527d64e486ddb0297fda04a7f76b4911f14eea42fe08.
The new catalog preserves every existing entry and appends only Crossglide.

External engineering idea
Oldham coupling: offset parallel shafts connected through perpendicular
sliding interfaces. The closure equations in this package were independently
derived from the declared dimensions and guide directions.

Primary manufacturer reference, consulted 2026-10-21 for the general
mechanical principle and terminology only:
Ruland Manufacturing, Oldham couplings and installation instructions.
https://www.ruland.com/oldham-style-coupling/
https://www.ruland.com/mosc41-15-ss.html
No manufacturer CAD, animation, photograph, diagram, code or prose is copied.
No commercial product's load rating or tolerances are attributed to our model.
DMG-Lib was not used for this machine. No NC or unlicensed mechanism content
is incorporated in the add-on.

External application and parts
Brickwright Lite, unchanged commit
df32b7ff33595406ce7356d249ec61baec1fecf6:
https://github.com/CrispStrobe/brickwright-lite
Registered compiler revision:
7d3f8be7c13091a635d919c1af5c456230eed8fd
These external dependencies retain their own notices and are not bundled.

Standard LDraw part names are references to the external Parts Library.
The source archive contains our model placements, not external part meshes.
Any CAD-derived preview is a separate attributed illustration, not part of
the original BSD-only source archive. See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
